scenes.style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo

beats.prompt: she breathes gently, chest rising once, then blinks slowly and opens her eyes again, and ends perfectly still
a warm smile slowly spreads across her face with a small tilt of the head, and she ends holding the smile

scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: she steps to one side and shifts her weight onto that leg while both arms rise to shoulder height, and ends there

she lowers her arms slowly while rolling her shoulders back, hips still swaying, and ends with hands on her hips
she steps to the other side, weight shifting, one arm sweeping across her body, and ends with that arm extended

scenes.name: finale
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo

beats.prompt: the sway slows to a stop, she exhales and lets her shoulders drop, and ends standing still
